c74object.name: evi_saw
c74object.digest: evieve Gen Object. Antialiased saw wave oscillator
c74object.description:
evi_saw is an abstraction for using inside gen~ or GenExpr.
evi_saw.gendsp requires the GenExpr file(s):
evi_polyblep_four.genexpr, evi_polyblep_utility.genexpr
evi_saw is also available in MSP as: evi.saw~.
Simple antialiased saw wave oscillator based on 4-point polyblep algorithm. The highest quality of the evieve polyblep oscillators. Including high frequency compensation.

geninlet.name: frequency
geninlet.digest: in Hz. Oscillator frequency in Hz.

geninlet.name: reset
geninlet.digest: (Naive). Oscillator phase reset, naive and not antialiased.
